snippet.title: Dig, Dig, Die | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A cooperative horror game for 1–6 players where you dig up graves to collect loot of varying value. Items can grant bonuses or apply negative effects, and enemies may appear during excavation. Monsters react to sound, including digging and proximity voice chat, increasing danger when players are loud. Collected loot is spent on a ship hub with vending machines that provide temporary boosts and a casino where resources can be risked. Playable solo or in co-op.

💰 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4074010/Dig_Dig_Die/
⚔️ Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/zzS9m6ApPx
💀 Follow us on X: https://x.com/Digdigdiegame
